profile.headline: Software Engineer | CompSci @ OSU | Electrical & Computer Engineering @ “The” OSU
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at General Dynamics Mission Systems, I apply my dual degrees in Electrical and Computer Engineering and Computer Science to design, develop, and test software solutions for complex and critical missions.

I have over seven years of experience in the industrial automation field, working with programmable logic controllers (PLC), distributed control systems (DCS), and a diverse set of data collection and analysis products. In my previous roles my work improved the efficiency, reliability, and safety of various production processes and equipment while enabling other engineers to gather insightful and actionable metrics to inform operational decisions.

I am passionate about leveraging my skills and knowledge to create innovative and impactful software solutions that support the defense, aerospace, and intelligence communities.
